insights: District Contractor Licensing: DC requires contractor licensing through DCRA DC Department of Consumer and Regulatory Affairs (DCRA) licenses contractors—verify at dcra.dc.gov. License is mandatory.
Extensive Historic Districts: Large portions of DC are historic districts DC Historic Preservation Office (HPO) review is required for many exterior changes. Reddit notes the process can be lengthy.
High Construction Costs: DC has very high construction costs DC labor and permitting costs are among highest in US. Reddit warns that very low bids indicate problems.
Strict Permitting: DC has rigorous permit requirements DCRA permitting is thorough and can be slow. Reddit emphasizes getting proper permits—enforcement is active.
